//: React Router does its routing in the browser, so /login only exists once
index.html has loaded and run. Asked for /login directly - a refresh, a
shared link, a bookmark - Vercel looked for a file at that path, found
nothing and returned its own 404 before React ever started.
This hands every unknown path to index.html and lets the router take it
from there. Real files are still served normally: Vercel checks the
filesystem first, so /assets/index-abc.js and /vite.svg are unaffected.
